title: aloe citrea
intro: Aloe citrea, commonly known as the Aloe deserticola or Desert Aloe, is a succulent plant species native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to soothe burns, wounds, and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aloe citrea include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and providing antioxidant protection. The bioactive constituents of Aloe citrea include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
